# LaunchAPropFirm — Institutional Proprietary Trading Firm

> LaunchAPropFirm (https://demo.launchapropfirm.com) is an institutional-grade proprietary trading firm empowering talented retail traders worldwide with up to $200,000 in funded capital, up to 90% profit splits, raw institutional spreads, and cutting-edge execution technology.

## Core Platform Highlights

- **Maximum Capital**: Up to $200,000 on evaluation accounts, with scaling plans reaching up to $2,000,000.
- **Profit Split**: 80% default profit split, scalable to 90% with funded milestones.
- **Trading Platforms**: MetaTrader 5 (MT5) with desktop & mobile connectivity, plus high-performance WebTrader with TradingView Lightweight Charts.
- **Instruments**: Forex majors and minors, Metals (Gold XAUUSD, Silver XAGUSD), Indices (US30, NAS100, SPX500, GER40), and major Cryptocurrencies (BTCUSD, ETHUSD).
- **Time Limits**: Zero minimum or maximum trading days. Traders pass at their own pace.
- **Drawdown Rules**:
  - Daily Drawdown: 5% trailing drawdown (ratchets with peak equity; protects challenges from sudden intraday losses).
  - Maximum Overall Drawdown: 10% maximum trailing drawdown floor.
- **Profit Targets**:
  - Phase 1: 8% profit target.
  - Phase 2: 5% profit target.
  - Funded Stage: No profit targets; keep up to 90% of all profits.
- **Payout Schedule**: Fast, reliable disbursals processed bi-weekly via Crypto (USDT TRC-20, USDT BEP-20) and international Bank Wire.
- **Exclusive Features**:
  - **Multi-Mode PvP Battle Arena**: Free Gladiator League (Mode 1), Cash Duels (Mode 2), and Challenge Perk Battles (Mode 3).
  - **Trading Tournaments**: Regular free and paid competitive tournaments with guaranteed cash prize pools and live leaderboards.
  - **Zenith AI Trader Copilot**: Real-time drawdown alerts, safe lot size calculation, macro news warnings, and tilt prevention.
  - **AI Trade Autopsy & Tilt Shield**: Automated post-trade grading (A–F), discipline scorecard, and self-imposed cooling-off modes.
